title: Agent folders
block: Block Agent sessions in {path} on {machine}: that computer stops collecting them, so nothing in Persona shows or counts them, and their permission requests are left to the agent's own interface
hide: Hide Agent sessions in {path} on {machine} from Agents and Persona's view (they keep running and stay recorded; active supervised tasks stay visible)
add_off: Add Agent folder rule {path} on {machine}, switched off (it does nothing until you switch it on)
switch_on: Switch on Agent folder rule {path} on {machine}
switch_off: Switch off Agent folder rule {path} on {machine} (its sessions show again; the rule stays)
to_block: Change Agent folder rule {path} on {machine} to Block (that computer stops collecting its sessions)
to_hide: Change Agent folder rule {path} on {machine} to Hide (its sessions are collected again but stay out of Agents and Persona's view)
remove: Delete Agent folder rule {path} on {machine} (its sessions show again)
